subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should OpenClaw keep the current Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or sponsor a built-in preset gallery and Custom Theme Studio in Control UI?
rationale: The current implementation and docs intentionally expose a narrower external-editor import model, while this request adds a larger in-product authoring and persistence surface that needs product/design ownership before code work.

options.title: Define a core theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in Control UI before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Document the existing import slot as the supported customization path and close or narrow the larger studio request after preserving the external editor alternative.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local variable editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a core theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in Control UI before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the live issue and authored the current custom-theme import path, so they are the best available routing owner for this product-direction choice.
